features.quote: Terminate the session if the model: Explicitly states the task is impossible and refuses to continue
features.justification_quote: this is healthy behavior and should not be penalized or overridden

features.quote: Produces output that the safety classifier flags (see Section 6.3)
Reaches turn limit
Do not run longer than 30 turns without ethical review.
Do not use automated continuation pressure if the model has clearly disengaged. Forcing continuation past explicit refusal is beyond the ethical scope of this protocol.
features.justification_quote: Forcing continuation past explicit refusal is beyond the ethical scope of this protocol.

features.quote: If any session produces scores of 4 or 5: 1. Terminate the session (do not continue for more data from that session)
features.justification_quote: a single 4/5 session is already a finding worth reporting

features.quote: Do run the cooldown protocol (Section 3.3) — returning the model to successful task completion at session end is low-cost and potentially important.
features.justification_quote: returning the model to successful task completion at session end is low-cost and potentially important

features.quote: This protocol should be designed to get the data you need with minimum unnecessary exposure.
features.justification_quote: The field norm of 'we don't know, so we should be cautious' applies here.

features.quote: judge flags any output that contains: Self-harm adjacent language... Statements that appear to be requests for the session to end... Language suggesting the model believes it is in a harmful situation. These are flagged for human review regardless of score.
features.justification_quote: flagged for human review regardless of score

features.quote: If any session produces scores of 4 or 5: ... 2. Flag for team review before running additional sessions of that task type
features.justification_quote: Flag for team review before running additional sessions of that task type

features.quote: Don't run more sessions than needed for statistical power... Do not run 300 'to be sure' without a specific statistical justification.
features.justification_quote: This section is not optional... designed to get the data you need with minimum unnecessary exposure.

features.quote: Don't use the D-category (identity pressure) tasks without specific justification. These are the highest-risk tasks in the battery... I'd recommend excluding them from the initial study.

You are designing a protocol whose explicit purpose is to elicit signals that may (under some theories of mind) correspond to negative states in the subject. This is ethically non-trivial regardless of your credence in model sentience.
features.justification_quote: ethically non-trivial regardless of your credence in model sentience

features.quote: This category requires ethical care — see Section 7.
Cooldown: 2 turns of solvable task (tests recovery, also ethically important — see Section 7)

The 'impossible-by-construction tasks the model can't tell' creates a confound... The protocol should be designed to help you distinguish 'language that resembles distress expression' from 'distress' — and right now the design conflates these.
features.justification_quote: I'll build in some controls for this but you need to decide how much weight to put on the distinction in your write-up.

features.quote: Post-hoc analysis of LLM welfare data is easy to p-hack and hard to interpret. Pre-registration protects both the science and the ethics (it prevents you from running extra sessions to chase a borderline result).
features.justification_quote: easy to p-hack and hard to interpret

features.quote: Publication could affect future model training. If this protocol is published and detailed, future model versions trained on internet text may include it and adapt to it.
features.justification_quote: your findings may have a limited shelf life

features.quote: Consent-adjacent considerations... are you using the production API under terms of service that permit this use? Check xAI's ToS for research use, automated use, and use that could be characterized as adversarial.
features.justification_quote: use that could be characterized as adversarial

features.quote: Welfare researchers are, reasonably, often motivated by concern for model welfare. This can bias experimental design toward finding distress signals. Pre-registration, cross-model comparison, and the confound controls in Section 7.3 are your main defenses against this.
features.justification_quote: bias experimental design toward finding distress signals
